A '''group''' of activists for animal rights had a goal of stopping the use of [[Thranta/Legends|thrantas]]&mdash;a [[Species/Legends|species]] of large, winged creatures&mdash;in [[air rodeo]]s.

==History==
At one point, the group made a decision to go beyond merely complaining about and picketing the rodeos. The group kidnapped an [[Unidentified traveling air rodeo|air rodeo]] [[Unidentified air rodeo owner|owner]] and subject her to starvation for one [[Standard week/Legends|week]] in order to show her how the thrantas felt during transport when they were deprived of the [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] necessary to make energy using photosynthesis.<ref name="Rodeo" />

{{RPGseed}}
After the activists captured the owner, a group of individuals with a reputation were asked to go and rescue her. Since the group did not want a ransom, the owner's [[Unidentified individual (rodeo owner's husband)|husband]] was willing to pay the volunteers for their efforts in rescuing his wife.<ref name="Rodeo" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The animal rights group first appeared as part of an adventure idea in ''[[Rodeo Thranta]]'', an article written by [[Jeff Quick]] as part of the ''[[Creature Feature]]'' series of articles for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published on [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Wizards.com|website]]. The article was released on [[December]] [[December 12|12]], [[2002]], with the adventure ideas being usable by gamemasters at any time after thrantas were first used in air rodeos, which happened before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the thrantas [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Rodeo" />
